senses.gloss:
मेघ, अस्, m. a cloud, (काल-म्˚, a black cloud);
cloudy weather; a mass, multitude; a fragrant grass,
Cyperus Rotundus; N. of one of the six Rāgas or
musical scales; of a Rākṣasa; of the father of the
fifth Arhat of the present Ava-sarpiṇī; of a poet,
(also read मेच); of a mountain; (अम्), n. talc;
[cf. Gr. ὀ-μίχ-λη; Goth. milh-ma, ‘a cloud;’
Lith. mig-la, ‘a mist.’]
—मेघ-कफ, अस्, m.
‘cloud-phlegm,’ hail.
—मेघ-कर्णा, f., N. of one
of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda.
—मेघ-काल,
m. ‘cloud-time,’ the rainy season.
—मेघ-कूटा-
भिगर्जितेश्वर (˚ट-अभ्˚, ˚त-ईश्˚), अस्, m., N. of
a Bodhi-sattva.
—मेघ-गम्भीर, अस्, आ, अम्,
deep as (the rumbling of) a cloud.
—मेघ-गर्-
जन, अम्, n. ‘cloud-rumbling,’ thundering, thunder.
—मेघ-गिरि, इस्, m., N. of a mountain.
—मे-
घङ्-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, ‘cloud-making,’ producing
clouds.
—मेघ-चिन्तक, अस्, m. ‘anxious for
clouds,’ the Cātaka bird (supposed to drink only
rain-water, and therefore naturally eager for rainy
weather).
—मेघ-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘cloud-born,’
coming from the clouds; (अस्), m. a large pearl.
—मेघ-जाल, अम्, n. ‘cloud-collection,’ a mass
of clouds, thick clouds; talc.
—मेघ-जीवक
or मेघ-जीवन, अस्, m. ‘living on clouds,’ the
Cātaka bird.
—मेघ-ज्योतिस्, इस्, n. (according to
[]
the Amara-koṣa, इस्, m.), ‘cloud-light,’ a flash of
lightning, the fire produced from lighting.
—मेघ-
डम्बर, अस्, m. thunder; [cf. मेघाडम्बर.]
—मेघ-तरु, उस्, m., Ved. ‘cloud-tree,’ a parti-
cular form of cloud.
—मेघ-तिमिर, अम्, n. ‘cloud-
darkness,’ darkness resulting from a clouded sky,
cloudy or rainy weather.
—मेघ-त्व, अम्, n. the
being a cloud, the state of a cloud, cloudiness; मे-
घत्वम् उप-गम्, to become a cloud.
—मेघ-
दीप, अस्, m. ‘cloud-light,’ lightning.
—मेघ-दुन्-
दुभि, इस्, m., N. of an Asura.
—मेघ-दुन्दुभि-
स्वर-राज, अस्, m., N. of a Buddha.
—मेघ-दूत,
अस्, m. ‘cloud-messenger,’ N. of a celebrated poem
by Kālidāsa.
—मेघदूत-पाद-समस्या, f., N.
of a work.
—मेघदूताभिध (˚त-अभ्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, entitled ‘cloud-messenger.’
—मेघ-द्वार, अम्,
n. ‘cloud-gate,’ heaven, the sky, ether.
—मेघ-
नाद, अस्, m. ‘cloud-noise,’ sound of rain, thunder;
(अस्, आ, अम्), sounding or rumbling like thunder,
making a noise like thunder; (अस्), m. an epithet
of Varuṇa; N. of one of the attendants of Skanda;
of a Dānava; of a son of Rāvaṇa, afterwards called
Indra-jit, as having conquered Indra (see Rāmāyaṇa,
Uttara-kāṇḍa XXXIV); of a frog; Amaranthus Po-
lygonoides; the Palāśa tree, Butea Frondosa.
—मे-
घनाद-जित्, त्, m. ‘conqueror of Megha-nāda or
Indra-jit, son of Rāvaṇa,’ an epithet of Lakṣamaṇa,
the favourite brother of Rāma (the account of his
fighting and killing Indra-jit is in Rāmāyaṇa,
Yuddha-kāṇḍa LXVII-LXX).
—मेघनाद-तीर्थ,
अम्, n., N. of a sacred bathing-place on the Narmadā
river.
—मेघनादानुलासिन् (˚द-अन्˚), ई, m. ‘re-
joicing in the rumbling of thunder-clouds,’ a peacock.
—मेघ-नादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, sounding or making a
noise like thunder; crying with joy at the appear-
ance of clouds; (ई), m., N. of a Dānava.
—मेघ-
नामन्, आ, m. ‘cloud-named,’ a fragrant grass, Cy-
perus Rotundus.
—मेघ-निर्घोष, अस्, m. the
rumbling of clouds, thunder; (अस्, आ, अम्), sounding
or making a noise like thunder.
—मेघ-पङ्क्ति,
इस्, f. a line or succession of clouds.
—मेघ-पर्-
वत, अस्, m., N. of a mountain.
—मेघ-पाली, f.
a proper N.
—मेघ-पुष्प, अम्, n. ‘cloud-
blossom,’ water; river-water; hail; (अस्), m., N. of
one of the four horses of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa.
—मे-
घ-पृष्ठ, अस्, m., N. of a son of Ghṛta-
pṛṣṭha.
—मेघ-प्रदीप, अस्, m., N. of a work.
—मेघ-प्रवाह, अस्, m., N. of one of the
attendants of Skanda.
—मेघ-प्रसव, अस्, m.
‘cloud-offspring,’ water.
—मेघ-बद्ध, अस्, m.
epithet of a particular formula.
—मेघ-बल, अस्,
m. a proper N.
—मेघ-भगीरथ-ठक्कुर,
अस्, m., N. of an author.
—मेघ-भूति, इस्, m. a
thunderbolt.
—मेघ-मञ्जरी, f., N. of a daughter
of king Vijaya-pāla.
—मेघ-मठ, अस्, m., N. of
a monastery or college built by and named after
Megha-vāhana.
—मेघ-मण्डल, अम्, n. the
sphere of the clouds, region of the clouds, firma-
ment, atmosphere.
—मेघ-मय, अस्, ई, अम्,
formed or consisting of clouds, cloudy.
—मेघ-
माल, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘cloud-wreathed, cloud-capt,’
crowned with clouds; (अस्), m., N. of a mountain;
of a Rākṣasa; of a son of Kalki by Ramā; (आ), f. a
line or succession of clouds, gathering of clouds; N.
of a work by Ketali-kīrtti treating of the astrological
significance of various kinds of clouds; of one of the
Mātṛs attending upon Skanda.
—मेघ-मालिन्, ई,
इनी, इ, cloud-wreathed; (ई), m., N. of one of
Skanda's attendants; of an Asura; of a king.
—मे-
घ-योनि, इस्, m. ‘cloud-source,’ smoke, fog.
—मेघ-
रव, अस्, m. ‘cloud-noise,’ thunder; (अस्, आ, अम्),
thundering like a cloud; (आ), f., N. of one of the
Mātṛs attending upon Skanda.
—मेघ-राग, अस्,
m. the musical scale Megha (being supposed capable
of bringing down rain from heaven).
—मेघ-राज,
अस्, m., N. of a Buddha.
—मेघ-राजि, इस्, or मे-
घ-राजी, f. a line of clouds.
—मेघ-राव, अस्, m.
‘cloud-sounding,’ a kind of water-bird.
—मेघ-
रेखा or मेघ-लेखा, f. a line of clouds.
—१. मे-
घ-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, enveloped in clouds, overcast
with clouds; (आन्), m., N. of a mountain.
—२. मे-
[]
घ-वत्, ind. like a cloud.
—मेघ-वन, N. of
an Agra-hāra named after Megha-vāhana.
—मेघ-
वपुस्, उस्, m. ‘cloud-form,’ a mass of clouds which
appear to assume some shape.
—मेघ-वर्ण, अस्,
आ, अम्, ‘cloud-coloured,’ having the hue of a cloud;
(अस्), m., N. of a man; of a crow in the Hitopadeśa;
(आ), f. the indigo plant.
—मेघ-वर्त्मन्, अ, n.
‘cloud-path,’ the atmosphere, sky.
—मेघ-वह्नि,
इस्, m. ‘cloud-fire,’ lightning.
—मेघ-वासस्, आस्,
आस्, अस्, ‘cloud-robed,’ clad in clouds; (आस्), m., N.
of a Daitya.
—मेघ-वाहन, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘having
clouds for a vehicle,’ riding upon the clouds; (अस्),
m. an epithet of Indra; of Śiva; N. of a king; of
a king of Kaśmīra; of the twenty-second Kalpa.
—मेघ-वाहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, riding upon a cloud;
(इनी), f., N. of one of the Mātṛs attending upon
Skanda, (also read मेष-वाहिनी.)
—मेघ-वितान,
अस्, m., Ved. ‘cloud-canopy,’ an expanded mass of
clouds, a sky overcast with clouds; (अम्), n. a par-
ticular metre, four times ˘˘¯˘˘¯˘˘¯¯.
—मे-
घ-विस्फूर्जित, अम्, n. the rumbling of clouds,
thundering; thunder; (आ), f., scil. वृत्ति, a parti-
cular metre, four times ˘¯¯¯¯¯, ˘˘˘˘˘¯, ¯˘
¯¯˘¯¯, (in this sense also अम्, n.)
—मेघ-
वृन्द, अम्, n. a mass of clouds.
—मेघ-वेग,
अस्, m. a proper N.
—मेघ-वेश्मन्, अ, n. ‘cloud-
abode,’ the sky, atmosphere.
—मेघ-श्याम, अस्,
आ, अम्, dark as a cloud.
—मेघ-सख, अस्, m.
‘cloud-friend,’ N. of a mountain.
—मेघ-सङ्-
घात, अस्, m. an assemblage or multitude of clouds.
—मेघ-सन्देश, अस्, m. = मेघ-दूत, q. v.
—मेघ-सन्धि, इस्, m., N. of a king of Magadha.
—मेघ-सम्भव, अस्, m. ‘cloud-produced,’ N.
of a Nāga.
—मेघ-सार, अस्, m. ‘cloud-essence,’ a
kind of camphor (= चीन-कर्पूर).
—मेघ-सु-
हृद्, त्, m. ‘cloud-friend,’ a peacock (described as
delighting in the rainy season).
—मेघ-स्तनित,
अम्, n. ‘cloud-rumbling,’ thunder.
—मेघस्तनि-
तोद्भव (˚त-उद्˚), अस्, m. Asteracantha Longi-
folia.
—मेघ-स्वन, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘cloud-sounding,’
loud as a (thunder) cloud; (आ), f., N. of one of the
Mātṛs attending upon Skanda.
—मेघ-स्वर or
मेघस्वर-राज, अस्, m., N. of a Buddha.
—मे-
घ-स्वाति, इस्, m., N. of a king.
—मेघ-ह्राद,
अस्, आ, अम्, shouting or roaring like a thunder-cloud.
—मेघाख्य (˚घ-आख्˚), अस्, m., N. of a Persian
king, (also read मेघाक्ष; = Prākṛt mehākkho);
(अम्), n. Cyperus Rotundus; talc.
—मेघागम
(˚घ-आग्˚), अस्, m. ‘approach of clouds,’ the rainy
season.
—मेघाच्छन्न or मेघाच्छादित (˚घ-
आच्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, overspread with clouds, covered
with clouds, clouded.
—मेघाटोप (˚घ-आट्˚), अस्,
m. ‘cloud-swelling,’ a dense cloud.
—मेघाडम्-
बर (˚घ-आड्˚), अस्, m. ‘cloud-drum,’ thunder;
[cf. मेघ-डम्बर.]
—मेघानन्दा (˚घ-आन्˚),
f. ‘rejoicing in clouds,’ a kind of crane.
—मेघा-
नन्दिन् (˚घ-आन्˚), ई, m. ‘rejoicing in clouds,’ a
peacock; [cf. मेघ-सुहृद्.]
—मेघान्त (˚घ-
अन्˚), अस्, m. ‘coming at the end of the rainy season,’
the autumn.
—मेघारि (˚घ-अरि), इस्, m. ‘cloud-
enemy,’ the wind.
—मेघावतत (˚घ-अव्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, overspread with clouds, overcast.
—मेघावली
(˚घ-आव्˚), f., N. of a princess.
—मेघास्थि (˚घ-
अस्˚), इ, n. ‘cloud-bone,’ hail.
—मेघास्पद (˚घ-
आस्˚), अम्, n. ‘cloud-region,’ the atmosphere, sky,
ether, heaven.
—मेघेश्वर-तीर्थ (˚घ-ईश्˚),
अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha on the Revā or Narmadā
river.
—मेघोदक (˚घ-उद्˚), अम्, n. ‘cloud-
water,’ rain.
—मेघोदय (˚घ-उद्˚), अस्, m.
‘cloud-rising,’ rising clouds.
—मेघौन्मुख्य
(˚घ-औ˚), अम्, n. the act of looking up eagerly
or longing for clouds (said of a peacock).

मेघय, Nom. P. मेघयति, -यितुम्, to make
cloudy, cause cloudy weather.

मेघाय, Nom. A. मेघायते, -यितुम्, Ved. to
form clouds, become cloudy.

मेघयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. making cloudy;
(अन्ती), f., N. of one of the seven Kṛttikās.
